subject: bugs in NIMBLE affecting (1) WAIC from multiple chains and (2) certain MCMC samplers for Bayesian nonparametric models

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: bugs in NIMBLE affecting (1) WAIC from multiple chains and (2) certain MCMC samplers for Bayesian nonparametric models
parts:
Dear nimble-users group members:

We've recently discovered a couple numerical errors in NIMBLE algorithms
that are fixed in the recently released NIMBLE version 0.7.0.

1) The first bug caused incorrect calculation of WAIC when calculated
from multiple MCMC chains for models with any non-scalar monitored
variables. Note that WAIC calculated from a single chain was not
affected by this bug.

2) The second bug caused incorrect MCMC updating for Bayesian
nonparametric models using the dCRP distribution in cases with the
following conjugacies between the base measure and the mixture kernel:

- dgamma base measure, dnorm kernel (mixing over the precision)
- dgamma base measure, dinvgamma kernel
- dbeta base measure, dbinom kernel
- dbeta base measure, dnegbin kernel
- ddirch base measure, dmulti kernel

Note that other conjugate situations, in particular the dnorm base
measure with dnorm kernel, as well as non-conjugate settings were not
affected by this bug.

We apologize for the errors and strongly encourage anyone who has used
WAIC in the fashion indicated above or used MCMC sampling on a BNP
model with the distributions indicated above to redo their
calculations using the updated 0.7.0 version of NIMBLE.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
